gal-congruences-generic: UpperTheory.Gal.Gen.DenseGen, with the hypotheses GenData, proved by denseGen_pf by iterating Step. Step is step_pf from SmoothAt, Tower (tower_pf, principal congruence subgroups), LevFacts, Ell, CountGen, StepCore and PartFacts; StepCore is stepCore_pf from AlgC and Codim.
gal-congruences-operators: Item (1) is UpperTheory.Gal.Int.Cong.exists_powOp (from UpperTheory.Cb.spherical_operators_exist), item (2) is exists_testOp (from GlobOp, SymEx and SatEx), item (3) is exists_op (from GlobalTheory.T.localOperator_acts_by_localComponentScalar) and item (4) is exists_scale, which takes k with l^k t both IntW and IntL.
gal-trace-limit: Approximation is GlobalTheory.Cong.PolyApprox (integer MvPolynomials, uniform in P). Item (1) is UpperTheory.Gal.Lim.exists_trace_limit, proved in the archive by a Cauchy argument as in the text; item (2) is GlobalTheory.Cong.exists_limit_rep: approximatedTraceSystem_locally_cauchy, extend_of_locallyCauchy, polyApprox_of_denseRange, isPseudoCharacter_of_approximatedByTraces, PsChar.exists_ssRep (Taylor's theorem, proved in the archive) and SSCont.continuous_of_continuous_trace.
gal-closed-crystalline: Item (1) is GlobalTheory.LimitTop.closedAtL (ClosedAtL), item (2) is GlobalTheory.CongPhi.ClosedPhi with JointApprox, proved by UpperTheory.Gal.ClosedPhiFromClosedTrace.congPhi_holds = congPhi_of_closedTr ClosedTr_holds powTr_holds. Approximation of traces is GlobalTheory.Cong.LinApprox. closedAtL uses TraceConjugationCover.cover_exists, producing a GlobalTheory.BKLim.Cover (a continuous Z_l-representation rho of dimension d read off to r by matrices b, with a tower of lattices whose layers lie in the algebra of finitely many members of C and whose traces approximate that of r to l^{-n}), pulls it back to the decomposition group (cover_pull), realizes r over a finite extension (exists_model_of_mem) and applies GlobalTheory.CovClose.closed_of_cover, which proves de Rham-ness, the Hodge-Tate multiplicities and crystallinity through Breuil-Kisin frames of bounded height of the layers (exists_breuilKisinFrame_semistable_boundedJumps). The Lean's statement is for covers, a weaker hypothesis in form than the limits of lattices of Berger (Limites de representations cristallines) and the deformation rings of Kisin; the text cites them for the closedness that the Lean proves its own way. Item (2) follows congPhi_of_closedTr: PowTr (powTr_holds, from AboveL.eig_pow_of_rep) turns the n-th power sums into traces at sigma^n, and ClosedTr is proved by closedTr_of from coverJ_holds (Lemma gal-cover-joint), frEx_holds (Lemma gal-cover-structures), fixOf_holds (Lemma gal-cover-weil-frobenius), opEx_holds (Lemma gal-cover-operators), tie_holds (Lemma gal-cover-trace-identity) and trLim_holds (Lemma gal-cover-trace-limit), in the order of the text. closedTr_of takes the Breuil-Kisin datum from BSP.nonempty_bk_of_finExt and the cyclotomic element from BSP.exists_isPer, pulls the cover back to the decomposition group by Cover.pull, and checks the hypotheses of FrEx through SstModel.main and IsJumpsAt.count_eq. ClosedTr also asks the members of C to be semistable at A, which congPhi_of_closedTr obtains from crystallinity (CrysSst.isSstAt_of_isCrysAt). The Weil-Deligne trace wdTr is iota^{-1} of minus the second coefficient of the characteristic polynomial of wdAt at g. The crystalline condition for l = 2 is in Lemma gal-structures-kisin and the etale bases of Step 1 in Lemma gal-structures-etale-basis; neither leaves an open step.
gal-cover-definition: GlobalTheory.BKLim.Reads (equi and one), Onto (equi: Pi rho'(g) = rho(g) Pi modulo l^n entrywise; surj: Pi S = 1 modulo l^n for some S), Tower (d', rho', Pi, onto, f, f_equi exact, f_Pi), Layer (m, rep with values in Cl, fields L_k containing L_0, rep_mem, b with entries in L_k, indep and span over Q_l, e, reads, c) and Cover (rho continuous, reads, tw with cont', lay, unit: Pi_n e'_n = e modulo l^n, trace: the displayed bound). Cover only asks Gamma to be a group with a topology, and the members of a layer may repeat. The absolute value is that of PadicAlgCl l, with |l| = 1/l.
gal-cover-joint: UpperTheory.Gal.ClosedPhiFromClosedTrace.CoverJ, with the JointApprox of the same namespace (one value theta approximated jointly with the traces), proved by coverJ_holds. Its proof is the construction of TraceConjugationCover.cover_exists, the cover of Lemma gal-closed-crystalline(1), run with approximations at epsilon = l^{-(n+K+c)} taken from the joint approximation. The steps of the text are T.exists_padicInt_span_image_lattice_regular (the lattice of r and its reading), T.small_traces_dvd_span_image (the constant c, from semisimplicity), TraceConjugationCover.traceL (the constant K), T.exists_finiteExtension_entries_of_compact_rep and T.exists_stable_spanning_finset_matrices (the fields L_rho' and the lattices Lambda_rho'), T.exists_lattice_layer_cover_basis_mod_pow (the layer lattice latT, the map Pi_n through Carries, the reading and the trace estimate, for M beyond some M_0 depending on n) and T.exists_equivariant_transition_matrix_cover (the transition matrices f_n). The text gives the facts these lemmas provide with short arguments; the archive's proofs of the T lemmas were not compared with them line by line.
gal-cover-breuil-kisin: (1) is GlobalTheory.BSP.BK: Wq l a is W(F_{l^a}) (the text writes h for a), Ep is E (monic, deg_pos, dvd_coeff, coeff_zero, not_expand), str is O_K = S/(E), flat is pi^flat, and ev is iota (ev_X, ev_C through wA, the Witt vectors of a fixed embedding of F_{l^a} into O^flat, ev_frob, span_ev, theta_ev, gal_w). BK also records that delta(E) is a unit and that S is complete for (l, E); these hold for every such E and are omitted in the text. (2) is BK.IsPer, with GlobalTheory.MemLoc.IsEps for zeta. (3) is GlobalTheory.BKLim.Frame extending Pre: T a unit over WCb l = W(C_l^flat), A A' = E^{2N}, phi, fix for the g with FixFlat (g fixes pi^flat), and gal with epsilon; rho is any function from G_K to d by d matrices over Z_l. Crystalline is Frame.IsCr. (4) is BKLim.Link on the matrices T. (5) is IsPerU. A_cris and B_cris are Per.Acris l and Per.Bcris l, and Q_l^ur enters B_cris through uB of a LocTied package. The archive calls these structures frames; the text does not, since frame names the almost tight frames of Chapter 5.
gal-cover-structures: (1) is BSP.nonempty_bk_of_finExt and BSP.exists_isPer. (2) is FrEx, proved by frEx_holds; its hypotheses ask, for every member and every realization R over a finite L containing L_0, IsSst P R with multV equal to the count in J, and IsCrys; in the text both follow from crystallinity with the given Hodge-Tate multisets. N is the maximum of |n| over the J(sigma). The proof uses T.isSemistable_latticeInMatrixAlgebraLayer, T.layer_DdR_bounds_alt, T.exists_breuilKisinFrame_semistable_boundedJumps (BKLim.exists_frame_sst) and T.exists_deRhamFrame_limitLattice_breuilKisinTower (BKLim.limit_frame_exists). (3) is T.breuilKisinPreframe_bounded_poles (BKLim.pre_bounded_poles), stated for the underlying Pre. The proof is written out through Lemmas gal-structures-datum to gal-structures-limit-frame, which follow the Lean's frEx_holds; the existence of crystalline structures on the layers (Lemma gal-structures-kisin) is cited from Kisin, Liu, Gao, Gee-Liu-Savitt for l odd and Du-Liu for every l.
gal-structures-datum: GlobalTheory.BSP.nonempty_bk_of_finExt. The Lean's structure BK also records that delta(E) is a unit (isUnit_δ) and that S is complete for the (l,E)-adic topology (complete); the proof checks both through BKReal.eisPoly_distinguished_complete, and the text proves the first, which is what the description of ker theta uses. The embedding of W(F_{l^h}) is BSP.Res.exists_witt_residue (thetaW, with Kunr l a <= K); the Eisenstein polynomial of a uniformizer is T.eisenstein_minpoly_uniformizer_witt_totallyRamified, a standard fact (Serre, Local Fields, I.6) that the Lean proves; the change of uniformizer pi + l when E lies in W[u^l] is EisShift.exists_uniformiser; S/(E) = O_K is bkStr_quotient_equiv (Weierstrass division); pi^flat and iota are BKReal.exists_ev_of_root; ker theta = (iota(E)) is BSP.span_eq_ker_theta_of_distinguished, using a generator xi of ker theta with theta(phi(xi)) = l (Prism.exists_generator). The Galois condition on W(F_{l^h}) is gal_wA.
gal-structures-twist: T.exists_ainf_unit_frobenius_eq_mul, proved by Per.frobenius_eq_mul_solvable from Per.LangUnit.lang_unit, which works over the Witt vectors of any perfect ring of characteristic l in which monic polynomials of positive degree have roots (Per.OCb_exists_root for O^flat). It is a Lang-type statement; the text follows the Lean's successive approximation.
gal-structures-cyclotomic: The existence is BSP.exists_isPer: zeta and its tilt come from MemLoc.exists_zeta_eps (IsEps e: e.untilt = 1 and the untilt of e^{1/l} is not 1), ker theta = (xi) is MemLoc.ker_theta_eq_span_xi (Fontaine's description, which the Lean proves), and eta from T.exists_ainf_unit_frobenius_eq_mul. The unit statements are BSP.isUnit_inclW_of_isPer, which also shows that tau and iota_A(tau) are nonzero and that every Galois conjugate of tau is a unit of W(C^flat); the unit iota(E) is derived from it inside pre_bounded_poles.
gal-structures-integral: FrobInt.frobenius_integrality (integral_of_frobenius, by step and approx: Z = Z_0 + l Z' with the same kind of equation for Z', and residue_integral for the valuation argument modulo l). HeightInt.frob_row_integral is the row form, phi(x_j) = sum_i x_i c_ij, used for bounded poles.
gal-structures-basis: BKLim.Pre: fields T, unit, A, A', A_mul (A A' = E^(2N)), phi (evW(E)^N . frobW(T) = T A), fix (zW(rho g) * galW g (T) = T for g with FixFlat g, that is g fixing pi^flat). BKLim.Frame extends Pre by eps and gal; the book's Breuil-Kisin structure is a Frame.
gal-structures-poles: BKLim.pre_bounded_poles, the proof of T.breuilKisinPreframe_bounded_poles (cited in Lemma gal-cover-structures(3)), stated for a Pre with any map rho. It uses BSP.isUnit_inclW_of_isPer and HeightInt.frob_row_integral on the rows of tau^N T and the columns of tau^N T^{-1}, with the identity evW(E)^N . frobW(T^{-1}) = A' T^{-1}.
gal-structures-saturated: T.ainf_principal_ideal_saturated_closed, proved by AinfSat.mem_ideal_of_saturated: divide by the unit c and apply mem_range_of_pow_mul, which reads off the Witt components of l^r y (coeff_pow_mul_add) and takes l^r-th roots in O^flat (exists_of_pow_eq). The Lean applies it with c = 1 (frame_of_links, limvec_mem) and with c = ev(X) = [pi^flat] (isCr_of_link).
gal-structures-layer: Crystallinity is the second half of T.isSemistable_latticeInMatrixAlgebraLayer (LayerSst.main), which also gives semistability: coordEquiv identifies Q_l^{d'} with the product over k and over columns of L_k^a, and isSst_sum, isSst_resQ, BlockSum.isCrys_sum and BSCoeff.isCrys_resQ_iff conclude. The bound is T.layer_DdR_bounds_alt (LayerJumps.layer_DdR_bounds), whose conclusion is DdR <= FilV(-N) and DdR meet FilV(N+1) = bottom, and whose hypothesis on the members is IsSst with multV equal to the counts in J; the text states the hypotheses as crystallinity with the given Hodge-Tate multisets, as in Lemma gal-cover-structures(2).
gal-structures-kisin: T.exists_breuilKisinFrame_semistable_boundedJumps (BKLim.exists_frame_sst) assumes a cyclotomic element of the datum (one always exists, Lemma gal-structures-cyclotomic) and only semistability with the bounds on D_dR; it gives a Frame of height N with the de Rham condition IsDR (used inside the proof to lower the height to N) and with IsCr when rho is crystalline. The book states the crystalline case without IsDR, which Lemma gal-cover-structures does not use. The Lean proves the lemma by its own construction for every l (crys_seed through SeedExists.exists_seed: B_cris period matrix, Frobenius over W, periods over A_cris, B_dR^+-lattices and the modification of the filtration; exists_breuilKisinFrame_semistablePeriods; exists_breuilKisin_frame_height_of_jumps_le with exists_hodge_basis_deRham_lattice). The text cites Kisin [Kis06, Cor. (1.3.15), Lem. (2.1.15)] for the Breuil-Kisin module of a lattice with Hodge-Tate weights in [0,h], of E-height h; Kisin's T_S(M) = Hom_{S,phi}(M, S^ur) is contravariant and his weights are non-negative, so the module of the Lean's structure is that of the dual of a twist by the cyclotomic character, with the comparison divided by the N-th power of a period of that character. Liu [Liu10, Thm. 2.3.1], which assumes p >= 3, puts the Galois action on R-hat tensor_{phi,S} M inside W(R) tensor_{phi,S} M, the Frobenius twist of the Lean's A_inf-span (eps(g) is phi^{-1} of Liu's matrix). For every p, including p = 2, Gao's Breuil-Kisin G_K-modules [Gao23, Def. 7.1.1, Thm. 7.1.7] carry the Galois action on W(R) tensor_S M itself, with covariant conventions and M fixed by G_infinity. For l odd, [GLS14, Prop. 5.9] gives tau(x) - x in u^p phi(t) (W(R) tensor_{phi,S} M) for a lattice in a crystalline representation, which after phi^{-1} gives [pi^flat] | eps(g) - 1 (IsCr). For every p, including p = 2, Du and Liu [DL26, Thm. 3.2.1] show, for a lattice in a crystalline representation with Kisin module M embedded in T^dual tensor A_inf without Frobenius twist (their map iota_M, the Lean's convention after the dual and the twist), that a lift tau-tilde in G_K of an element tau with tau(u) = [eps] u has matrix X with entries in A^(2), a subring of A_inf [DL26, Cor. 2.4.5]; tau-tilde and G_infinity topologically generate G_K [DL26, Section 3.2, proof of Lem. 3.2.3]. With X = 1 modulo I_+ = W(m_R) [Gao23, Def. 7.1.1(5), Thm. 7.1.7] and I_+ A^(2) contained in u A^(2)_st, inside u A_inf [DL26, Lem. 3.3.1(3)], this gives (tau-tilde - 1)(M) in u A_inf tensor_A M, the step written in the proof of [DL26, Cor. 3.3.4]; this is IsCr for tau-tilde, and IsCr for every g follows by the density argument of the text. The Lean's IsCr is weaker than the l odd statement of GLS14 (which has the extra factor phi(t)) and is the form of Du-Liu's step. Gao's crystallinity criterion [Gao23, Prop. 7.1.10], (tau - 1)(M) in t W(m_R) tensor_S M, holds for every p but does not by itself give divisibility by [pi^flat], and Wang's extension of [GLS14, Prop. 5.9] to p = 2 (Math. Res. Lett. 29 (2022), Prop. 4.1) is for a uniformizer with K_infinity cap K(mu_{2^infinity}) = K. The Lean does not use these results: it proves the lemma for every l by its own construction from crystalline periods, IsCr coming from the trivial cocycle kappa = 1 of the crystalline seed (T.exists_trivial_cocycle_crystalline_period_data).
gal-structures-functorial: T.exists_equivariantMap_breuilKisinMatrix (BKLim.EquivKisin.main), stated for Pre of heights N and N', a cyclotomic element, and f equivariant for all of G_K. It is a special case of the full faithfulness of Kisin's functor on modules of finite height [Kis06, Prop. (2.1.12)], which needs equivariance only for G_infinity. The Lean proves it itself: X = T'^{-1} f T is fixed by G_infinity, lies in O_E by T.mem_OE_of_invariant_frobenius_solution, and in S by T.exists_powerSeries_lift_of_period_pow_smul_integral_matrix (BSP.KisinFF.main) since tau^(N+N') X is integral by pre_bounded_poles.
gal-structures-limit: T.exists_breuilKisin_basis_limit_lattice (BKLim.limit_pre_exists), for a Pre on every rho'_n. O_E is BK.OE; the properties cited from Fontaine are OEDvr.main (T.integral_elements_unit_factorization) and T.breuilKisin_OE_stability_properties; S -> W(C^flat) is injective by BSP.BK.evW_isUnit_injective_dvd. Steps: 1 is T.exists_etale_basis_limit_lattice_tower (EtaleLimit.main, with T.exists_etaleBasis_modPow and the functorial lemma; the Lean indexes the etale bases by k+1); 2 is T.limit_breuilKisin_basis_invariant_etale (LimBasis.main); 3 is T.approximatingLattices_transitionMatrix_modPow (TransLim.main); 4 is T.latticeApproximation_mittagLeffler (BKLim.mittagLeffler_approx, with flatPow_dvd_perPow_mod, proved there through BSP.BddDen.main, and T.breuilKisin_descent_coefficients_ainf_mod_pow, which is fact (b)); 5 is T.mittagLeffler_image_breuilKisin_modPow (ImageTower.ml with T.finite_breuilKisin_quotient_prime_pow_X_pow); 6 is T.limitVector_mem_OE_and_ainf (limvec_mem); 7 is T.limitVectors_invertible_basis_over_OE (LimVec.invertible_basis); 8 is T.saturatedAinfLattice_free_over_breuilKisin (SatLat.main through T.ainf_closed_membership_limit); 9 is T.twisted_matrix_congruence_lift_sequence (limit_basis_link_mod); 10 is T.ainf_exists_mul_eq_pow_smul_of_mod_lPow (AinfInvLim.exists_mul_eq_smul_one); 11 is T.invariantEtaleBasis_change_by_OE_unit (ChangeEtaleBasis.main); 12 is T.breuilKisin_basis_of_etale_invariant_bounded_poles (pre_of_etale, using BSP.KisinFF.main, which is fact (a)); 13 is T.exists_right_inverse_mod_pow_of_ev (descend_rightInverse: BSP.AinfTopBasis.main and BSP.pow_l_mem_span_coeff) with T.ainf_rightInverse_up_to_pow_mod_lPow (AinfRinv.rinv_mod_pow). The Lean's argument is its own; Berger's closedness of crystalline representations (Ber04) and the limit theorems for torsion representations of finite E-height are related results, not used. O_E is Definition gal-structures-etale; facts (a) and (b) are Lemma gal-structures-descent; the freeness in Step 8 is Lemma gal-structures-free; the topological basis and the power l^r in Step 13 are Lemmas gal-structures-topological-exists and gal-structures-coefficients. The congruence u^c = tau^(2N) y modulo l^n in Step 4 follows BSP.BddDen.main: a Teichmuller multiple [b] of a unit x of W(C^flat) lying in A_inf is u^(c_0) plus a multiple of l, and the geometric sum gives the n-th power modulo l^n. The etale bases B_k of Step 1 are T.exists_etaleBasis_modPow, Lemma gal-structures-etale-basis, which the Lean applies at level k+1 in its indexing; it is written out through Lemmas gal-structures-points to gal-structures-smith.
